name: smwsprites-ghost-guy
title: Ghost Guy
description:
A ghost Shyguy from SMW2:YI. It wanders around on ground, occasionally stopping, then moving again. It can be stomped and also eaten by Yoshi.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Sprite Pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
